metadata.case_name: HO CHI MING v. UNION RIFE HONG KONG LTD.

plaintiff.occupation_after: repair worker at public housing estates

injuries.description: old fracture of the 4th lumbar vertebral body
source: Initial X-rays had shown an old fracture of the 4th lumbar vertebral body.

injuries.description: retropulsion or bursting of the 4th lumbar fracture which led to indentation of the thecal sac and the 4th lumbar nerve root
source: a myelogram and CT scan was performed in November 1994 which revealed a retropulsion or bursting of the 4th lumbar fracture which led to indentation of the thecal sac and the 4th lumbar nerve root.

injuries.description: arachnoiditis (as the likely cause of the Plaintiff's persistent symptoms)
source: Dr. Lau formed the view that the Plaintiff's persistent symptoms is most likely due to arachnoiditis and expected these symptoms to persist as there were no further treatment, medical or surgical, which could help him.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of nerve root of lumbar spine

manifestations.description: intense pain at his lower back radiating down to his legs
pain in his legs, in particular the right leg and frequent leg cramps at night
stiffness in the Plaintiff's leg and also the lower spine region
there was clumping of the nerve root at the 4th lumbar
the Plaintiff would not be able to return to his pre-accident employment as a deckhand but could take up some light work

treatments_received: spinal fusion and pedicle screw fixation (operation in July 1995)

losses.description: persistent pain in the lower back and legs likely to remain for the rest of his life
would not be able to return to his pre-accident employment as a deckhand
